answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The gale is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ledge. By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on invitation quota tree, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit.
